raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE SUMMARY
Business Analyst with 7 years of experience across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Fund Administration, and Transfer Agency at Citi and Tata Consultancy Services. Skilled in requirements elicitation, business analysis, stakeholder management, impact analysis, UAT, and Agile delivery for large-scale transformation and regulatory initiatives. Strong domain expertise in Fund Administration and Transfer Agency, with hands-on experience across trade lifecycle, transaction processing, corporate actions, reconciliation, and investment operations. Recognised for independently identifying 41%+ of defects during a major application revamp, improving release quality and reducing production risk through structured business analysis, business validation, and effective stakeholder collaboration.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst | Citi Bank (Citicorp Services India Pvt Ltd.) | 07/2022 – Present | Bengaluru, India
Managed the end-to-end requirements lifecycle from elicitation, analysis, documentation, and validation through


UAT, business sign-off, and release readiness, ensuring solutions aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and investment operations. Engaged stakeholders across front, middle, and back-office teams to elicit requirements, develop BRDs and user stories, and validate business outcomes across Paxus, GTAS, and Zilo Transfer Agency platform enhancements and releases. Assessed cross-functional and cross-initiative impacts of proposed system changes, identifying dependencies, operational risks, and downstream impacts across trade lifecycle, reconciliation, and reporting processes.
Developed and maintained BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, RTMs, process maps, and impact



assessments, ensuring end-to-end traceability across business and technology initiatives. Performed gap analysis across business processes and system capabilities, identifying requirement gaps across 100+ issues, assessing impacts on trade lifecycle, corporate actions, reconciliation, and investor servicing, and recommending practical business solutions. Facilitated stakeholder workshops, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives to resolve ambiguities, align scope, and support Agile delivery across cross-functional teams. Supported change management by documenting process changes, conducting impact assessments, and securing stakeholder sign-offs across regulatory, risk, and operational control initiatives.
Owned end-to-end UAT across major and minor releases, covering test planning, execution, defect management,

root cause analysis, business validation, and release sign-offs to ensure production readiness. Led UAT for a major application revamp, independently identifying 41%+ of all defects and providing go/no-go recommendations that improved release quality and reduced production risk.
Conducted business analysis and UAT across trade lifecycle processes, validating subscriptions, redemptions,


transfers, settlements, corporate actions, and reconciliation to ensure accurate end-to-end transaction processing and business rule compliance. Acted as the liaison between Operations, Technology, Product Owners, and Business SMEs, translating business requirements into functional solutions through impact analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and end-to- end transaction lifecycle analysis. Performed SQL data validation across upstream and downstream systems, verifying trade, holdings, fee, and reconciliation data to ensure end-to-end data integrity.
Coordinated and mentored junior analysts on requirements analysis, documentation standards, defect triage, and

business validation activities, driving consistent delivery quality across the analysis function. Leveraged AI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, impact assessments, and traceability documentation, reducing turnaround time by approximately 10% across the delivery lifecycle.
Agile Test Engineer | Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. | 09/2019 – 07/2022 | Gurgaon, India


Analysed business requirements (BRDs, FRDs and user stories) to design test plans, test cases, and RTMs, ensuring complete requirement coverage across DTCC Global Trade Repository (GTR) Manage Services for onboarding, LEI management, trade reporting permissions, and regulatory enhancements. Performed functional, regression, integration, boundary, and negative testing across DTCC GTR Manage Services, validating onboarding, reporting permissions, billing, audit trail, and regulatory reporting workflows while managing the end-to-end defect lifecycle using JIRA and HP ALM.
Collaborated with Business Analysts, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to identify requirement
gaps early in the sprint cycle, contributing to high-quality Agile deliveries.
Conducted API testing and backend SQL validation to verify business rules, reference data, reporting




permissions, and data integrity across upstream and downstream systems. Supported UAT by validating business scenarios, analysing defects, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure solutions met business requirements and release readiness. Tested regulatory enhancements supporting EMIR and SFTR reporting requirements, validating user access controls, reporting permissions, and compliance with business rules. Built and maintained Selenium-Java automation scripts using TestNG and Maven, reducing manual regression effort across sprint cycles. Participated in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, supporting Agile delivery and continuous improvement.
raw_sections.skills:
KEY SKILLS
BA Core: Requirements Elicitation & Analysis, BRD/FRD Documentation, User Story Writing, Gap & Impact Analysis, Acceptance Criteria Definition, Process Mapping, Change Management.
UAT Leadership: End-to-End UAT Planning, Entry/Exit Criteria, Go/No-Go Recommendations, Business Sign-off Coordination, UAT Artefact Management.
Stakeholder Management: Cross-functional Collaboration, Impact Assessments, Stakeholder Signoffs, Risk & Compliance Alignment.
Domain: Capital Markets, Investment Operations, Fund Administration, MultiFonds, Transfer Agency, Trade Lifecycle, Securities Processing, Financial Transaction Processing, Corporate Actions, Settlement & Reconciliation, Investor Onboarding (KYC/AML), Regulatory Reporting & Compliance.
Documentation: SOPs, RTMs, Process Maps, UAT Sign-off Evidence, Audit-ready Artefacts, Confluence.
Technical: SQL, JIRA, HP ALM, Microsoft Office Suite.
Agile & Delivery: Scrum, Kanban, Sprint ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Cross-functional Dependency Management.
AI Tools: Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot - for requirements analysis and documentation acceleration.
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
Citi Bronze Award – Takes Ownership | Issued by Assistant Vice President | Dec 2025
Recognised for exceptional attention to detail, identifying gaps in requirements and proactive stakeholder communication during UAT delivery — valued for high-quality documentation and standards ownership.
Citi Silver Award – Takes Ownership | Issued by Vice President | Jul 2024
Independently led end-to-end requirements validation and UAT for a fully revamped application with more than 350+ new requirements from analysis to release sign-off while identifying more than 41% of all defects during the release, reducing production risk and improving overall test efficiency.
Citi Silver Award – Succeeds Together | Issued by Vice President | Aug 2023
Awarded for owning a major release delivery - proactively identifying and escalating critical issues early, improving delivery quality through structured gap analysis and cross-team collaboration.
